items.question: How do I get started with the platform?
items.answer: Create your account, choose the right plan, and start managing your clinic with ease. Everything you need is in one place.

items.question: Is my data safe and secure?
items.answer: Yes. Your data is protected using modern security and encryption standards. Your privacy and your patients' privacy are our priority.

items.question: Can I use the platform on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. The platform works on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Access it anytime, anywhere.

items.question: What payment methods are available?
items.answer: We offer secure and convenient payment options. Simply choose the method that works best for you during checkout.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time. Your plan won't renew after cancellation.
